newsitem.title: USA: Peak Q3 sales rise 75 pct from Q2.
newsitem.headline: Peak Q3 sales rise 75 pct from Q2.

text.p: Peak Technologies Inc, an Internet software company, said Friday that sales in the third quarter, ended June 30, were C$703,336, compared with C$401,504 for the previous quarter, a 75 percent increase.
The company said this sales increase is especially significant because retail distribution was impacted by a change in the product name from Net.Jet to PeakJet in the quarter.
Year-to-date revenues grew 95 percent to C$1,419,399 compared with C$727,272 in the year-earlier period.
In the fourth quarter, Peak said it expects further expansion of retail distribution resulting from an agreement with Ingram Micro Inc, and new promotions with retailers.
